card.name: Digits and names in chemistry citations
card.fires_on: Marked pieces inside reference lists of crystal engineering and supramolecular chemistry papers, such as page-number digits and parts of author names. It is strongest in citations to journals like Cryst. Growth Des. and CrystEngComm.

modes.label: Page-range digits
modes.description: A digit inside a page range in a journal citation.

modes.label: Author name pieces
modes.description: Part of an author's name or initial in a chemistry citation list.
modes.example: Hurley, E.P.;<< Des>>per, J.; Natali, M
